jobs.title: Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Technical Outsource Manager (m/w/d) in Berlin. Unser Team bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für einen Technischen Outsourcing-Manager (m/w/d), der als Vermittler zwischen unserem High-Tech-Kunden und den Remote-Teams in Bulgarien fungieren wird. Als Technischer Outsourcing-Manager schaffen, pflegen und erweitern Sie Geschäftsbeziehungen, indem Sie langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden aufbauen und verwalten. Sie fungieren als Bindeglied zwischen dem Kunden und dem Team in Bulgarien und unterstützen diese mit Ihrem technischen Wissen und umfassenden Erfahrungen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner werden Sie neue Leads managen und diese zu Nearshoring-Projekten entwickeln; Engineering-Anfragen diskutieren und Einblicke aus verschiedenen Kundenabteilungen einbringen. Sie sind für Kundenbeziehungen verantwortlich und der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei den betreffenden Projekten in einem komplexen, anspruchsvollen und sich häufig ändernden Umfeld. Sie haben ein Auge dafür, Abweichungen in Qualität, Lieferzeit und Budget zu erkennen, diese anzusprechen und zu managen. Um das Bewusstsein für die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu schaffen, bringen Sie diese „Signale“ und das Kundenfeedback in das Team ein. Sie gewährleisten eine bidirektionale Kommunikation und managen Eskalationen vom Team in Sofia zum Kunden. Ihre Erfahrung bringt Verantwortung und Eigenverantwortung in die Projekte, was sicherstellt, dass unsere Lösungen nachhaltig und umfassend in die Organisationen unserer Kunden eingebettet sind. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert. Worum es geht Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon. Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung. Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu. Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sale

If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. jobs.description: About ALPAMI At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way. We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in. The Role We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. Und wir sind auf einem sehr guten Weg dorthin. Damit wir weiter wachsen können, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent:in im Customer Success & Support. Du hilfst unseren Kunden dabei, FunnelCockpit erfolgreich im Alltag einzusetzen – freundlich, lösungsorientiert und mit technischem Verständnis – und das flexibel neben deinem Studium. So arbeiten wir Wir sind ein Remote-First-Team ohne klassisches Büro. Du arbeitest zu 100% im Homeoffice – wenn du möchtest, auch in einem Co-Working Space. Für die Zusammenarbeit nutzen wir moderne Tools: Slack für Kommunikation und schnelle Absprachen Linear für Aufgabenplanung und Ticketmanagement Intercom für den direkten Kontakt mit Kunden Bei uns hast du immer ein offenes Ohr: Deine Ideen und Fragen sind willkommen, und wir haben Raum für kreativen Austausch. Du wirst von Anfang an intensiv betreut und mit einem Mentor an deinen Aufgaben begleitet. Aufgaben Du betreust unsere Kunden über Intercom – schriftlich, freundlich und lösungsorientiert. Du unterstützt neue Kunden beim Onboarding und hilfst ihnen, schnell erste Erfolge mit FunnelCockpit zu erzielen. Du dokumentierst Anfragen in Linear und arbeitest eng mit unserem Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam zusammen. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations. The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale. This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction. jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. Your mission UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance. It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job. You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role overview As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved. Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth. Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. jobs.description: About SeeSicht Gmbh SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes. You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien. Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging. Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn. In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken. Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten: Je hebt een sterke basis in; Python Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure) Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL) Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery) Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster) Terraf

We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments. If you're ready to make an impact, embrace the unknown, and collaborate with a talented group of visionaries, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities You will explore novel research directions in 3D generation, reconstruction, and world models. jobs.title: Engineering Fellowship
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use. The work depends on where you can have the most impact. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done. You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. Unsere Kunden bestellen online, wir fertigen offline und senden es dann direkt an unsere Kunden – bis vor die Haustür. Klingt verrückt? Dachten wir auch und darum mussten wir es ausprobieren. Der Erfolg gibt uns Recht. 2020 gegründet, konnten wir bis heute über 100.000 Kunden überzeugen. Das erwartet dich Warum klickt ein Kunde auf das eine Produkt – und am anderen vorbei? Welche Produktbilder, Titel, Sortierungen oder Darstellungen führen dazu, dass mehr Besucher kaufen? Genau das findest Du heraus. Du vergleichst unterschiedliche Varianten unserer Produktlistings und findest heraus, welche besser performen. Du planst und begleitest A/B-Tests, zum Beispiel für Produktbilder, Produkttitel, Sortierungen, oder weitere Elemente der Produktdarstellung. Du wertest die Ergebnisse anhand relevanter Kennzahlen aus, etwa Klickrate, Conversion Rate und Umsatz. Du erkennst, wo Kunden im Shop Potenzial liegen lassen, und leitest konkrete Optimierungsvorschläge ab. Du dokumentierst Deine Tests und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar, damit wir aus jedem Experiment lernen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem E-Commerce-Team zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unseren Shop einfacher und erfolgreicher machen können. Du arbeitest 10 bis 15 St./Woche. Anwesenheit im in unserem Office in Hamburg Lurup wäre ideal, ist aber kein Muss. Das bringst du mit Idealerweise studierst du E-Commerce, Medien, Werbung oder Marketing. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Google Analytics 4, Google Sheets oder Excel. Du kannst Zahlen analysieren und daraus verständliche Schlussfolgerungen ziehen. jobs.title: Customer Journey Manager Automotive (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über die Bovensiepen Group Was 1965 in Kaufbeuren als Vision von Burkard Bovensiepen begann, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit unverwechselbarer DNA. Seit Jahren wird das Familienunternehmen von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian geführt und steht für automobile Meisterwerke, handwerkliche Exzellenz und Perfektion in jedem Detail. Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Mit dem Übergang der ALPINA Markenrechte an BMW beginnt jetzt für die Gruppe ein neues Kapitel. Die automobile Leidenschaft wird unter der eigenständigen Marke Bovensiepen mit neuer Ausrichtung weitergeführt. Sechs Sparten bilden dabei das Rückgrat der Unternehmensgruppe, die Transformation als Chance versteht. Für den Ausbau unseres Gebrauchtwagengeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und handelnde Führungspersönlichkeit. Ihre Rolle – Kundenerlebnis, Auftrag und Weiterentwicklung in einer Hand Sie verantworten das Kundenerlebnis für zwei Fahrzeugwelten: unsere Bovensiepen-Neufahrzeuge, die in unserer Manufaktur in Buchloe nach Kundenwunsch entstehen, und unsere Certified Cars, geprüfte und aufbereitete Premium-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge. Ab der ersten Anfrage begleiten Sie den Kunden Hand in Hand mit unseren Verkaufsberatern und Handelspartnern: Der Vertrieb führt das Verkaufsgespräch, Sie machen den gesamten Weg bis zur Übergabe und die Zeit danach zu einem Erlebnis. Ihre Kunden erwarten, dass jedes Detail sitzt und schätzen jede Idee, die ihr Fahrzeug noch persönlicher macht. Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns in dieser Form zum ersten Mal. Sie übernehmen keinen fertigen Prozess, Sie gestalten ihn: Welche Momente begeistern unsere Kunden? Wie sieht eine Übergabe aus, von der sie noch Jahre später erzählen? jobs.title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
jobs.description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? Research questions you could initially work on Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control? Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected? Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics? Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site? These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next. Our cloud-based platform, supply chain and services help landlords run repairs, maintenance and compliance faster, with the data to make decisions instantly. jobs.description: Vos missions Vos missions Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale. Principales responsabilités * Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits. * Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques). * Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences. * Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance. * Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads. * Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts. * Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps. * Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme. * Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes. Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. jobs.title: Growth - France (CDD)
jobs.description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market. This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time. This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth. You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. This role will own: Winning new business Go-to-market strategy and execution Client onboarding and implementation support Account management and expansion What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success) Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.) Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market

We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. About the role Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France. At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world. We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value. You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions. You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility market

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

jobs.description: About Alma At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we ve empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we re just getting started! About the team Strategic Finance is part of Alma s Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma s economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products. We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma s P&L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached. About the job Own your piece of the P&L. Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.
